feature: The deck order's memory, and the colour control's box
note: Two small rulings on three routes. The `/decks` rows open the sort menu, because that is where the capitalised labels are drawn and a closed trigger only shows the one in force. The colour rows are a plain `goto`: the box that was lopsided is the rack's WIDE form, so the desktop cell is the evidence and the phone cell is the same control in its sheet form, which draws no box at all. No `shares` block — the colour control is already one component (`ui/colour-pips.tsx` inside `rack/colour-control.tsx`), which is why one 6px padding fixed both lanes at once. Steps are Playwright verbs.
